summary: On the main deck, Tank speed-reads the reams of Matrix code. He announces that he has found a patch on an old exit at Wabash and Lake, a hotel, Room 189.

what_changes.before: Searching through the Matrix code for an exit while Neo is under pursuit.
what_changes.after: Has located a specific exit: "a patch on an old exit. Wabash and Lake. A hotel. Room 189".
what_changes.evidence: I got a patch on an old exit. Wabash and Lake.  A hotel.  Room 189

event_hint.one_line: Tank finds an exit for Neo to reach during the Agents' pursuit.
